_comment: Deterministic launch registry for common published MCP servers. Capped at ~10 entries by design (see roadmap Review Notes) — this is not meant to be an exhaustive package index. Anything not listed here falls back to model knowledge, flagged as unverified.

fetch._note: Not an npm package — @modelcontextprotocol/server-fetch 404s. Distributed as a Python package, launched via uvx.

git._note: Not an npm package — @modelcontextprotocol/server-git 404s. Distributed as a Python package, launched via uvx. --repository is required; substitute <path> with the target repo.

sqlite._note: Not an npm package — @modelcontextprotocol/server-sqlite 404s (archived from the npm scope). Distributed as a Python package, launched via uvx. --db-path is required; substitute <path> with the target database file.
